sentences.text: The petitioner could have accepted the award under protest and agitated the matter further if he wants change of categorization.

4. Learned State Counsel has further pointed out that though the name of the petitioner is not in the notification, Patna High Court CWJC No.18013 of 2021(9) dt.14-05-2024 the name of his vendor is there.

5. In that background, learned Senior Counsel submits that the entire process before the Circle Office was completed and in that background, his name should have been there in the notification.
6. He submits that he will be filing certified copy of the order of mutation as also will make a categorical statement that the names were already incorporated in Register-2 of the Circle Office, so far as the present land in the name of the petitioner is concerned.
7. He as such, seek time for filing supplementary affidavit.
8. List this case on 15th of July, 2024.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Neha/-
